name: What immediate steps should I take if a storm damages my home?

mainEntity.name: What immediate steps should I take if a storm damages my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: After a storm hits, document every area of visible damage with date-stamped photos and clear notes before touching anything. Promptly cover broken windows or leaks to prevent worsening conditions, and contact your insurance company to open a claim. Hiring a residential contractor like HH Remodeling LLC gives you a single contact to evaluate the scope of repairs across framing, drywall, and finish carpentry. Taking detailed photos of water stains, roof-leak intrusions, and damaged trim early provides the accurate documentation adjusters need during their site inspections.
acceptedAnswer.description: Take photos of all damage, temporarily patch leaks or openings to prevent further damage, notify your insurer, and schedule an inspection with a repair contractor.
